scope: Local library transaction bridge safety and interoperability readiness; no real library transaction.
user_confirmed_blocker: Chưa được cấp quyền hoặc API.

real_library_validation.reason: The library has not issued permission or an API. Local simulations cannot establish real token validity, loan ownership, renewal eligibility, upstream idempotency, or actual due-date changes.

current_configuration.source: Application configuration loaded locally; presence booleans only. No endpoint values or credentials are included.
current_configuration.health_flag_limit: library_configured currently reports renewal URL presence only; it is not an external connectivity, authorization or readiness check.

local_verification.environment: Temporary SQLite stores and synthetic app accounts. HTTPX MockTransport or mocked transaction service; no library network IO.
local_verification.command: .\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_transaction_contract.py tests/test_integrations.py tests/test_operations.py tests/test_renewal_receipt_session.py tests/test_loans_session.py tests/test_final_review.py -q -k "transaction_contract or library or renewal or inflight or late_receipt or sent_renewal" --junitxml=docs/validation/2026-11-07-transaction-contract-junit.xml
checked_behaviors: Anonymous requests cannot call loan or renewal providers.
Missing/false confirmation returns 422 before sending or inserting a renewal ledger entry.
Unconfigured renewal returns 503 without sending or creating a ledger entry.
Saved successful receipt is cached for the same authenticated account/loan/key; changed payload or another account conflicts without revealing receipt.
Concurrent duplicate returns a conflict while first request is pending; only one provider call occurs.
Uncertain renewal survives application restart and blocks same-key and different-key retries for the same app account/loan.
Reader cannot view admin transaction ledger or reconcile; admin reconciliation records an audit entry and a stable official-reference receipt.
Revoked/expired sessions cannot receive private loan data or renewal receipts; authorized provider result is retained.
Late provider callbacks cannot overwrite final reconciliation or a replacement account reusing a numeric ID.
Timeout/invalid or mismatched acknowledgement/invalid JSON/date leaves renewal uncertain; no automatic resend.
Tokens are not stored in the renewal ledger; bridge output filters extra upstream fields.
local_verification.warning: Starlette TestClient emitted its existing httpx deprecation warning. No dependency was changed.

minimal_fix.change: Align Renewal.loan_id max_length from 128 to the existing bridge limit of 200.
minimal_fix.root_cause: library_loans/library_renew already accept IDs through 200 characters, so the API previously rejected valid returned IDs of length 129-200.
minimal_fix.red_evidence: Before the fix: 129- and 200-character IDs returned 422 rather than 200 (2 failing assertions); 201 characters remained rejected.
minimal_fix.green_evidence: After the fix: all 49 selected transaction tests pass, including accepted 129/200 and rejected 201 lengths.

bridge_contract.implementation: Existing configurable bridge; no EMICLIB/UTH API implementation or issued endpoint is assumed.
bridge_contract.loans: GET LIBRARY_LOANS_URL, Authorization: Bearer reader token; HTTP 200 JSON loans array (at most 500), stable id or loan_id (at most 200 chars), optional ISO due_date.
bridge_contract.renew: POST LIBRARY_RENEW_URL, Authorization: Bearer reader token, Idempotency-Key; JSON loan_id. Confirmation requires HTTP 200 JSON status=renewed, matching loan_id and valid due_date.
bridge_contract.network: Full HTTPS URLs, port 443, certificate verification, public unicast DNS and pinned Host/SNI. Private/VPN bridges require a separately reviewed deployment.
bridge_contract.reconciliation: Durable local pending/uncertain ledger; manual admin reconciliation with explicit confirmation/reference (and date for success). No automatic upstream status polling.
bridge_contract.ownership: The approved upstream bridge must scope each token to its reader and enforce loan ownership, eligibility and idempotency. Chatbot account authentication does not itself prove library reader identity.

external_inputs_required.requirement: Written library authorization naming the integration/test environment, operations, allowed data, test window and responsible library contact.
Library-issued endpoint documentation/OpenAPI or agreed bridge schema, approved full HTTPS loan/renew URLs, auth/token issuance and expiry/revocation contract.

Library-owned synthetic/test reader token and an eligible test loan, its authoritative current due date, plus controlled rejection cases. Do not send a password or token into repository/report/chat logs.
Upstream idempotency guarantees: account/loan binding, key retention period, duplicate behavior, timeout reconciliation procedure and official receipt/status access.

Confirmation of response mapping. The adapter supports HTTP 200 confirmed renewed receipts only; 201/202/204, alternate status/date fields, pending operations or a different auth scheme need a documented adapter change and contract tests.
Authorized acceptance operator and evidence procedure to verify loan state before/after one explicitly confirmed renewal and resolve uncertain results without blind resend.

real_acceptance_sequence_after_authoriza: Configure only the supplied test endpoints; validate TLS/network and documented schema without guessing routes or logging credentials.
Use the issued test token for a read-only loan query and compare reader/loan identity and due date against the library authoritative record.
Confirm one eligible test renewal with a single idempotency key. Compare returned loan ID/date and official library receipt/state.
Replay the same key under the documented test contract and verify one actual upstream operation through library evidence; do not assume local cache proves upstream idempotency.
Use only approved synthetic denial/expiry cases to verify ownership, eligibility, expired tokens and safe error disclosure.
Exercise uncertain status only in a provider-controlled sandbox, then reconcile against an official record before any resend.
not_verified: No real library account authentication, reader token, loan, eligibility decision, renewal, reservation or due-date change.
No upstream idempotency, transaction reconciliation, availability, quotas or live transaction load.
No production deployment or modification of runtime/user data.
